tournaments.tournamentGroup.name: BEIJING
tournaments.tournamentGroup.metadata.tournament_summ: China Open

Since 2004, the women of the WTA have competed in the China Open, a WTA 1000 tournament played on outdoor hard courts. 96 singles players and 32 doubles teams battle for 1,000 points in the standings and a chance to earn a prestigious title, cementing themselves alongside former singles champions like Serena Williams, Iga Swiatek and 2024 champion Coco Gauff. The China National Tennis Center in Beijing has hosted the China Open since 2009, with its signature Diamond Court holding 15,000 fans.
tournaments.title: China Open - Beijing, CHN

tournaments.tournamentGroup.name: SUZHOU 125
tournaments.tournamentGroup.metadata.tournament_summ: Suzhou Open

The Suzhou Open, also known as the Suzhou Ladies Open, is WTA 125 tournament founded in 2013. Originally held as a WTA 125 event for its first two years, this contest has returned to the WTA Tour calendar as of 2025. 32 singles players, 16 qualifiers, and 16 doubles teams compete at the Sungent International Tennis Center in Suzhou, China to become champion and add to this event’s growing history.
tournaments.title: Suzhou Open - Suzhou, CHN

tournaments.tournamentGroup.name: SAMSUN 125
tournaments.tournamentGroup.metadata.tournament_summ: Samsun Open

The Samsun Open is a WTA 125 event played on outdoor hard courts at the Green Golf & Tennis Club. 32 singles players, 16 qualifiers and 16 doubles teams have competed at this event in Samsun, Turkiye since 2025.
tournaments.title: Samsun Open - Samsun, TUR

tournaments.tournamentGroup.name: WUHAN
tournaments.tournamentGroup.metadata.tournament_summ: WUHAN OPEN

The Dongfeng Voyah · Wuhan Open is a staple of women’s tennis. Founded in 2014, this WTA 1000 event returned to action in 2024 after a four-year hiatus. 56 singles players and 28 doubles teams compete on outdoor hard courts in Wuhan, Hubei, China. The Optics Valley International Tennis Centre is the site for this tournament. It holds seven courts, including the Central Court stadium that can host up to 15,000 fans. Past Wuhan Open champions include multi-time winners Aryna Sabalenka (singles) and Martina Hingis (doubles).
tournaments.title: Wuhan Open - Wuhan, CHN

tournaments.tournamentGroup.name: MALLORCA 125
tournaments.tournamentGroup.metadata.tournament_summ: Mallorca Women’s Tennis Championships

tournaments.tournamentGroup.name: WTA FINALS
tournaments.tournamentGroup.metadata.tournament_summ: WTA Finals

The crown jewel of women’s tennis takes place in Indian Wells, California, USA! The WTA Finals is the pinnacle of the sport, with eight singles players and doubles teams that have qualified in the PIF WTA Race to the Finals competing for tennis’ ultimate prize. Matches are played in a round-robin format between two groups of four, with the top two players or teams from each group moving on to the knockout stage. WTA Finals is contested on the courts of the Indian Wells Tennis Garden. The WTA Finals has showcased the best athletes in women’s tennis for over 50 years. They have spanned the globe – from the first-ever WTA Finals in Boca Raton, to New York City, Istanbul, Singapore, and more of the world’s biggest cities. Who will be crowned WTA Finals champion? Which singles star will raise the Billie Jean King Trophy? Which doubles team will earn the Martina Navratilova Trophy? We’ll all witness history being made in Indian Wells.
tournaments.title: WTA Finals Indian Wells

tournaments.tournamentGroup.metadata.tournament_summ: LP Open by IND

tournaments.title: LP Open by IND - Colina, CHI

tournaments.tournamentGroup.metadata.tournament_summ: Argentina Open

tournaments.tournamentGroup.metadata.tournament_summ: OPEN IN ARTE ANGERS LOIRE

The venue holds up to 6,500 fans eager to see who takes home the Open In Arte Angers Loire title. The Open In Angers Loire was founded in 2021 and is one of the last WTA 125 tournaments of the season.
tournaments.title: Open Angers Loire Trélazé - Angers, FRA

Founded in 2014, this WTA 1000 event returned to action in 2024 after a four-year hiatus. 56 singles players and 28 doubles teams compete on outdoor hard courts in Wuhan, Hubei, China. The Optics Valley International Tennis Centre is the site for this tournament. It holds seven courts, including the Central Court stadium that can host up to 15,000 fans. Past Wuhan Open champions include multi-time winners Aryna Sabalenka (singles) and Martina Hingis (doubles).

RoveretOpen Citta della Pace is a WTA 125 tournament played on indoor hard courts in Rovereto, Italy. Since 2025, 32 singles players and 16 doubles teams compete at this event annually in an effort to win a title from PalaBaldresca.

content.title: RoveretOpen Città della Pace - Rovereto, ITA

metadata.tournament_summary_text: The Lisboa Belem Open has officially joined the WTA Tour calendar for 2026. 32 singles players and 16 doubles teams will gather on the clay courts of Club Internacional de Foot-ball in Lisbon, Portugal to compete for the Lisboa Belem Open title in the tournament’s inaugural run as a WTA 125 event.

content.title: Río Ladies Open by MundoTênis Tours  - Rio De Janeiro, BRA

metadata.tournament_summary_text: The Kinoshita Group Japan Open, also known as the Japan Women’s Open, is a WTA 250 event played on outdoor hard courts in Osaka, Japan. 32 singles players and 16 doubles teams compete at Utsubo Tennis Center, which holds 5,000 fans in its main stadium court. The Kinoshita Group Japan Open became a women's-only event for the first time in 2009. After a three-year hiatus, the event returned in 2023 at the WTA 250 level.

content.title: Kinoshita Group Japan Open - Osaka, JPN

metadata.tournament_summary_text: The Ningbo Open is a WTA 500 tournament played on outdoor hard courts in Ningbo, China. 28 singles players and 16 doubles teams competed at the Ningbo Tennis Center to earn 500 points in the standings and a Ningbo Open title. Founded in 2010, the Ningbo Open became a WTA 125 event in 2013 and was elevated to the 500 level in 2024.

The Queretaro Open is a WTA 125 tournament played on outdoor clay courts in Queretaro, Mexico. Since 2025, 32 singles players and 8 doubles teams gather annually at Club Campestre de Queretaro to compete for a WTA 125 title. The inaugural 2025 tournament marked the first time in Queretaro history that the city hosted an international tennis event.

content.title: Valle D'Aosta Ladies Open - Courmayeur, ITA

metadata.tournament_summary_text: The Toray Pan Pacific Open is a WTA 500 tournament played on outdoor hard courts in Tokyo, Japan. The event started in 1973 and has a rich history with the WTA. One of the premier events in the Asian Swing, 28 singles players and 16 doubles teams compete to earn 500 points in the standings and a Pan Pacific Open title.

content.title: Toray Pan Pacific Open Tennis - Tokyo, JPN

metadata.tournament_summary_text: The Guangzhou Open is a WTA 250 tournament played on outdoor hard courts in Guangzhou, China. The former Guangzhou International Women’s Open features 32 singles players and 16 doubles teams competing at the Nansha International Tennis Center to earn 250 points in the standings. The event joined the Hologic WTA Tour calendar in 2004, the year that Chinese tennis superstar Li Na won the inaugural title.

The Curitiba Open is a new WTA 125 tournament played on outdoor clay courts in Curitiba, Brazil. 32 singles players and 8 doubles teams will compete at the Graciosa Country Club vying for the inaugural Curitiba Open title.

The WTA Tour first returned to India in 2022 with the inaugural Chennai Open. The event came back once again 2025 and is now an annual fixture of the WTA 250 slate. 32 singles players, 16 qualifiers, and 16 doubles teams compete on the outdoor hard courts of SDAT Tennis Stadium.

The Cali Open is a new WTA 125 event played in Cali, Colombia. 32 singles players and 8 doubles teams will gather to the outdoor clay courts of Club Campestre de Cali, as they compete to become the inaugural Cali Open champion.

The Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open is a WTA 250 tournament played on outdoor hard courts in Hong Kong, China. 32 singles players and 16 doubles teams compete to earn 250 points in the standings and a Hong Kong Tennis Open title. The tournament was first contested in 1980, and it returned to the calendar in 2014 after a two-decade hiatus, becoming an integral part of the Asian Swing.

content.title: Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open - Hong Kong, China
American Tennis Open Miami - Miami, FL, USA

metadata.tournament_summary_text: The Angola Ladies Open is a new WTA 125 event played in Luanda, Angola. 32 singles players and 16 doubles teams will compete on the outdoor hard courts at Kikuxi Tennis Academy to become the inaugural Angola Ladies Open champion.

The crown jewel of women’s tennis takes place in Indian Wells, California, USA! The WTA Finals is the pinnacle of the sport, with eight singles players and doubles teams that have qualified in the PIF WTA Race to the Finals competing for tennis’ ultimate prize. Matches are played in a round-robin format between two groups of four, with the top two players or teams from each group moving on to the knockout stage. WTA Finals is contested on the courts of the Indian Wells Tennis Garden. The WTA Finals has showcased the best athletes in women’s tennis for over 50 years. They have spanned the globe – from the first-ever WTA Finals in Boca Raton, to New York City, Istanbul, Singapore, and more of the world’s biggest cities. Who will be crowned WTA Finals champion? Which singles star will raise the Billie Jean King Trophy? Which doubles team will earn the Martina Navratilova Trophy? We’ll all witness history being made in Indian Wells.

The LP Open by IND is one of two WTA 125 clay-court events in South America during November. Colina, Chile, hosts this tournament, which has been part of the WTA 125 tier since 2022, when Mayar Sherif took the title. 32 singles players and 12 doubles teams will vie for this year's titles.

content.title: LP Open by IND - Colina, CHI

metadata.tournament_summary_text: The IEB+ Argentina Open is one of two WTA 125 clay-court events in South America during November. This event takes place in the Argentine capital of Buenos Aires, and it has been part of the WTA 125 schedule since 2021. 32 singles players and 8 doubles teams will try to take home this season's trophies.

content.title: IEB+ Argentina Open - Buenos Aires, ARG

metadata.tournament_summary_text: The Open In Arte Angers Loire is a WTA 125 tournament played on indoor hard courts in Angers, France. 32 singles players and eight doubles teams compete at Arena Loire Trelaze to earn 125 points in one of the first events after the WTA Finals. The venue holds up to 6,500 fans eager to see who takes home the Open In Arte Angers Loire title. The Open In Angers Loire was founded in 2021 and is one of the last WTA 125 tournaments of the season.

content.title: Open Angers Loire Trélazé - Angers, FRA
Champions Reel: How Leylah Fernandez won Singapore 2026
content.description: No. 6 seed Leylah Fernandez captured her sixth career WTA Tour Driven by Mercedes-Benz title, second at WTA 500 level and first on indoor hard courts at the 2026 Singapore Tennis Open. Fernandez upset top seed Mirra Andreeva in the quarterfinals for her second Top 5 win of 2026 and eighth of her career, and went on to lift her first trophy since Osaka 2025.

metadata.tournament_summary_text: Since 2004, the women of the WTA have competed in the China Open, a WTA 1000 tournament played on outdoor hard courts. 96 singles players and 32 doubles teams battle for 1,000 points in the standings and a chance to earn a prestigious title, cementing themselves alongside former singles champions like Serena Williams, Iga Swiatek and 2024 champion Coco Gauff. The China National Tennis Center in Beijing has hosted the China Open since 2009, with its signature Diamond Court holding 15,000 fans.
